parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Compound **F**, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_8\text{O}_3$, shows stereoisomerism and effervesces with $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3\text{(aq)}$.

Compound **F** reacts with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ to form yellow precipitate **G** and compound **H**.

Compound **F** reacts with $\text{LiAlH}_4$ to form compound **J**, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_2$.

Compound **F** reacts with $\text{SOCl}_2$ to form compound **K**, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_7\text{O}_2\text{Cl}$.

Compound **K** reacts with propan-2-ol to form compound **L**.

Draw the structures of compounds **F**, **G**, **H**, **J**, **K** and **L** in the boxes in Fig. 7.3.
